[SWS_DM_00363] Unsupported Subfunction
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04005
⌈
If the requested subfunction value is not configured (no instances of
DiagnosticSe-
curityAccess
with
requestSeedId
, as well as the corresponding CompareKey val-
ues), a negative response 0x12 (
kSubFunctionNotSupported
) shall be returned.
